results.alertTitle: Anonymous sharing link created by adelev@m365x816222.onmicrosoft.com

summary.tpReason: The alert is corroborated by a matching OfficeActivity_CL AnonymousLinkCreated event at 2021-11-04 20:33:21Z for the named file, account, IP, and OneDrive URL. The same session shows SharingSet with Contribute/Edit permissions, a successful sign-in burst, and additional suspicious account activity.
summary.fpReason: There is no benign business justification in the available telemetry, and the account/IP/session correlation is strong. The only residual uncertainty is that the telemetry does not identify who used the anonymous link or prove a subsequent download.
summary.whatHappened: On 2021-11-04, adelev@m365x816222.onmicrosoft.com used Microsoft 365 from 175.45.176.99 (geolocated IL in sign-in telemetry) with a Chrome/Edge browser. At 20:33:20–20:33:21Z, the account broke sharing inheritance and granted Contribute/System.LimitedEdit permissions, then created an anonymous Edit link for OneDrive file Contoso Purchasing Data - Q1.xlsx. The account had 53 successful and 3 failed sign-ins from that IP during the day, across multiple Microsoft applications. Between 20:17:06 and 20:43:42Z, OfficeActivity also records file downloads, uploads, sends, a new inbox rule, deletions, and other sharing activity. A separate correlated Sentinel alert reports 12 Azure resources deleted by the same account at 20:34Z from 37.142.150.162.
keyEvidence: OfficeActivity_CL: AnonymousLinkCreated at 2021-11-04 20:33:21.057Z for the exact file, by adelev@m365x816222.onmicrosoft.com from 175.45.176.99; Event_Data specifies Type=Edit.
OfficeActivity_CL: SharingSet and SharingInheritanceBroken at 20:33:20.057Z for the same file; permissions included Contribute and System.LimitedEdit, and the link group was an AnonymousEdit link.

sign_in_adelete_CL: 56 sign-ins on 2021-11-04 for the account, 53 successful/3 failed, all from 175.45.176.99 across Azure Portal and numerous Microsoft 365 applications; location IL and browser user agent are consistent.
SecurityAlert: 12 Azure resources deleted by AdeleV@M365x816222.OnMicrosoft.com from 37.142.150.162 at 2021-11-04 20:34:00.672Z.
OfficeActivity_CL: 151 account events from 20:17:06–20:43:42Z, including FileDownloaded, New-InboxRule, FileDeleted, Send, FileUploaded, and additional sharing operations.

Historical exact-file search found only the creation/sharing events and no FileDownloaded or FileAccessed event attributable to an anonymous recipient; this limits proof of actual retrieval, not proof that the public edit link was created.
researchDone: Validated the alert against OfficeActivity_CL using the exact account, IP, timestamp, operation, filename, and URL.
Inspected the sharing sequence and permissions around 20:33Z, including SharingInheritanceBroken, SharingSet, GroupAdded, and AnonymousLinkCreated.
Reviewed sign_in_adelete_CL for 2021-11-04: successful/failed counts, applications, IP, location, user agent, and risk fields.
Reviewed OfficeActivity_CL for the account from 20:17:06–20:43:42Z for downloads, uploads, mailbox activity, inbox rules, deletions, sends, and other sharing.
Searched all available OfficeActivity_CL history for the exact file; no recipient access/download was found.
Reviewed SecurityAlert for same-day correlated detections; found the 12-resource deletion alert and 53-successful-sign-ins alert.
Queried AzureActivity_CL around the reported deletion time, but no underlying deletion rows were present; the SecurityAlert record remains the source for that detail.
